subject: Engagement plan (initial draft) + timeline options — please confirm stakeholders
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Engagement plan (initial draft) + timeline options — please confirm stakeholders

Hi Daniel / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Attached is an initial engagement plan (v0.1) that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and two timeline options. This is intentionally a starter doc so we can lock in responsibilities and a target close date.

Quick summary (see attached for table view):
- Goals: Pilot Redwood inference for clinical-notes summarization in production for 2 clinics (approx. 20k notes/month).
- Milestones (high level):
  1) Security & compliance review (answer questionnaire + SOC2 evidence) — owner: Novamed IT (security) & Redwood security.
  2) POC dataset provisioning & synthetic-data run — owner: Novamed data eng + Redwood solutions.
  3) Integration sprint (API + auth) — owner: Novamed eng + Redwood eng (deployment support).
  4) Pilot validation (quality & latency evaluation) — owner: Novamed PM + Redwood CS.
  5) Production handoff / billing & SOW execution — owner: procurement/legal + Redwood sales.

Dependencies called out in the attachment: SOC2 evidence (if not already available, 2–3 business days to provide standard artifacts), procurement lead time (SOW + PO — typically 2–3 weeks for accounts of your size), and dataset access/consent checks.

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (aggressive): 6 weeks from kickoff — target close: 2026-12-20. Requires immediate SOC2 Q&A response and fast-track procurement.
- Option B (recommended): 10 weeks from kickoff — target close: 2027-01-15. Built-in buffer for procurement and security review.

Ask/next steps:
1) Please confirm which timeline you prefer (Option A or B).
2) Confirm the primary stakeholders on each milestone (I included placeholder owners in the sheet).
3) Can we schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff next week to assign owners and set a weekly checkpoint?

Attachments: Engagement_Plan_v0.1.xlsx (single-sheet milestones + responsibility matrix), SOW_template-draft.pdf.

If you’d rather I convert the milestones to a shared Jira board, happy to do that once owners are confirmed.

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

> Thanks again for the discovery call today. Attached is an initial engagement plan (v0.1) ...

Thanks Aditya — the doc looks good and covers what we discussed. A few quick notes from Novamed: 

- Timeline: we prefer Option B (10 weeks) to give procurement and clinical review time. Target close ~2027-01-15 works for us.
- Stakeholders: I am the product sponsor (Daniel Park). Priya will own clinical validation. Please loop in Amit Rao (Head of Data, amit.rao@novamed.com) for dataset provisioning — cc'ing him here.
- Security: Novamed IT security asked for the SOC2 summary and a list of data flows (they flagged PHI handling). Security has weekly review slots on Thursdays; can you share the SOC2 artifact and a short data-flow diagram?
- Procurement: we will need a short SOW and an internal PO. Procurement lead is Maya Fernandes (maya.fernandes@novamed.com) — I'll introduce her on the next thread.

Next step: PRIYA and I are available Tue 11/10 10–11am PT or Wed 11/11 2–3pm PT for the MAP kickoff. Please confirm which slot works.

Regards,
